description.value: New Amsterdam Bakery is a family-run Surrey bakery with over 25 years of experience producing handmade specialty breads, custom cakes, and pastries with no chemicals or preservatives. The shop offers vegetarian (egg-free), vegan, sugar-free, and salt-free options alongside classics like cinnamon buns, danishes, and Black Forest cake. For a touring cyclist, it is a practical stop to pick up fresh bread or baked goods in a residential Surrey neighbourhood next to a TD Bank.
